function: Show sustained phone attention and a progressively bent body, then reveal the whole posture

design.shape_language: elongated curved limbs and minimal face

constraints: Feet remain fixed in actor space
Hand and phone share one transform
Head and neck endpoints share the same target position
Camera changes do not alter actor pose
limitations: Timing is an initial fit from sparse observations, not a measured trajectory
No automatic support, contact or acting approval
Leg curves bend with fixed feet; weight shift is not physically validated
